chapter_title: Concerning the Five Saviours, the Resurrectors of
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation

**
¶2:** The
 fragment
 is too damaged
 to yield
 a
 coher
ent spiritual
 sense. What
 remains suggests
 only
 that
 some
 interior
 process
 is
 contained
 within a
 prior
 state —
 possibly
 the ind
welling of a new
 capacity
 for reception
 within
 the mind
 already
 prepared
.


**¶3:** The text
 names
 a
 second
 principle
 of
 spiritual
 restoration
 but
 the
 passage is lost
. The ord
inal
 sequence
 ("
second
 resurre
ctor")
 indicates
 a discrete
 degree
 of the
 divine activity
 by
 which what
 has
 fallen
 into spiritual
 death
 is raised
 again into
 life
 —
 but
 which
 degree
,
 and by
 what means, cannot
 be recovered
 here
.

**¶4:** The
 third
 principle of
 spiritual restoration is the Divine
 Love
 itself in
 its origin
 —
 the in
most proce
eding will
 from
 which
 all things first
 came
 forth
. For
 by
 Divine
 Truth
 proce
eding from
 that
 love, all living
 aff
ections of
 good and truth that
 had
 been scattered
 and
 dispers
ed through states
 of falsity are gathered back
 into order
 and drawn
 into
 conjunction
 with
 their
 source.
 There
 they
 receive
 the
 full
ness of what
 they l
acked —
 interior
 good
 flowing
 into their forms
 —
 and enter
 into the
 peace
 that
 belongs
 to those
 aff
ections when
 they rest
 in the
 Divine
 itself
,
 no
 longer lab
oring under
 opposition
.

**¶5:** The
 fourth principle of spiritual restoration is the Divine
 Wisdom as
 it
 enters
 and
 illumin
ates the understanding — the interior
 light by
 which the mind perce
ives truth
 as
 truth
 and
 is
 thereby
 raised out
 of darkness
.
 The
 remainder
 is
 lost
, but the correspondence
 is clear
: it
 is the infl
ux of heav
enly intelligence
 into
 the rational
 faculty that constit
utes this
 degree
 of restoration
.

**¶6:** The
 fifth principle of spiritual restoration toward
 all
 that
 is genu
inely good is again
 the Divine Love
 in
 its original
,
 self
-subsisting
 perman
ence — the will
 of the Divine
 which
 was
 established before
 all derived
 states
.
 This
 love sust
ains every
 faculty
 and capacity
 of
 the spiritual mind, and it stands
 imm
ovable as
 the
 ground
 beneath
 all changing
 states.
 It shall remove
 the cov
erings —
 the ve
ils of appearances
 and
 falsities
 — that
 had
 obscured the interior
 sight
 of
 those
 fac
ulties, and by
 the
 attractive
 power of love
 itself
 it
 draws
 them into
 conjunction
 with its
 own
 life
.
 According
 to the Divine
 purpose
 working
 through them
, it
 re
orders
 them
,
 and
 it
 raises
 them into
 their proper place within
 the heav
enly form
, and
 there
 they remain in
 a
 fixed
 state of good
 —
 ab
iding until
 the final ordering
 of all things is complete.

---


*
A
 note
 on the sequence
:* The text en
umerates degrees
 of the
 one
 divine
 act
 of
 regener
ation —
 restoration
 from
 spiritual
 death.
 That
 the
 "
Father
"
 appears
 at
 both
 the third
 and fifth
 degrees
 suggests the Divine
 Love operates
 at
 multiple discrete
 levels:
 once
 as
 the gathering
 of scattered
 affections through
 truth
, and again as the final
 unve
iling and
 permanent
 establishment
 of the whole
 mind
 in heav
enly order. The Light
 Mind at
 the fourth
 degree stands
 between
 them
 as
 the medi
ating intelligence
 —
 wisdom
 received
 into
 the understanding — by
 which the transition
 from the
 lower
 to the higher restoration
 becomes
 possible.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: And the third resurrector is the Father, the First [Man], because by his word shall all lives [that were scattered] gather in and go to him, and they receive [their light] and rest.
The fourth resurrector is the Light Mind, because [he descends upon every soul and illuminates the mind with the knowledge of truth, and by his light he raises it from the darkness of forgetfulness].

The
 fifth resurrector to the good [souls
] is the Father, the First established
 one [before all aeons]. [
He sustains] all the powers,
 and he stands firm [in his foundation
]. He shall unveil the [covering
 of darkness] over them [and remove
 it], and he draws them to him
 [by his power], his will [
working through them], and he [rest
ores] them, and he stands them
 up [in their place] there,
 and they remain until [the consumm
ation of all things].
